x-card.description: Read queries, schema, EXPLAIN. Writes wait for approval.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Where the core reaches the database. It connects from this machine, so your VPN and hosts file apply.

databases.title: Databases
databases.description: Only these databases are available through this connection.

sslMode.title: SSL mode
x-enumTitles: Auto (TLS when the server offers it, verified)
Verify the CA and host name (verify-full)
sslMode.description: Auto asks the server before signing in: when it offers TLS, the certificate and host name are verified as with verify-full; only a server without TLS gets an unencrypted connection. A certificate that fails verification is an error: add its CA below.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a private CA, with Auto, verify-ca or verify-full. Empty: the system trust store.

user.title: User
user.description: Use a user that can only read wherever you can. The test below shows what it may do.

password.title: Password
password.description: Leave empty when the server permits this user to connect without a password.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Timeouts, pool and schema allowlist. Policies can tighten them per environment.

statementTimeoutMs.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeoutMs.description: The database cancels slower statements. Empty: the environment policy.

schemaAllowlist.title: Schema allowlist
schemaAllowlist.description: Only these schemas are available to agents. Empty: every schema the user may use.

allowedFunctions.title: Functions reads may call
allowedFunctions.description: Your own functions that only read: a name for calls without a schema, schema.name for calls with one. Reads may call built-in functions; any other one waits for approval, and on prod it is refused.

defaultSchema.title: Default schema
defaultSchema.description: Where table names without a schema resolve. Empty: public.

discoveryDatabase.title: Discovery database
discoveryDatabase.description: Connect here to load the database list. Change it when your account may not connect to postgres: template1 works on most servers.
